exact.title: Exact name or alias
exact.shows: The input is already in the alias table; the alias strength sets the score: canonical 1.0, curated 0.97, generated 0.9, weak 0.8.

vendor.title: Vendor names and prefixes
vendor.shows: A bare vendor name maps to the vendor entity; a prefix such as MS only counts next to a product (D-41).

look-alike.title: Look-alikes kept apart
look-alike.shows: Names that share letters or words but are different products each resolve to their own id.

cleaning.title: Cleaning and retries
cleaning.shows: Versions are dropped, split words are joined, CamelCase is split at inner capitals, a trailing number is retried without it.

context.title: Same name, different products
context.shows: A bare shared name is ambiguous; a hint, a filter or a context word picks one (D-48).

semantic.title: Paraphrases (semantic layer)
semantic.shows: Vendor × concept phrases are compiled into aliases at build time; slang is rewritten at query time (D-49).

typo.title: Typos
typo.shows: Fuzzy matching fixes small misspellings, weighted by how rare each word is; words of 3 letters or fewer are never corrected.

outside.title: Must not resolve
outside.shows: Products outside the catalog stay unresolved even when they share words with known ones.

known-limit.title: Known limits
known-limit.shows: Cases the resolver misses today, tracked in docs/GAPS.md.
